function wrap(v: unknown) { return (_t: any, _c: any) => { console.log("w", v); }; }
class C { @wrap(typeof C) m() { return 1; } static y = 5; }
class D { @wrap(D.z) f = 1; static z = 2; }
class E { @((_t: any, _c: any) => { console.log(typeof E); }) m() { return 3; } }
class F { m() { return F; } }
console.log(new C().m(), new E().m(), new F().m());
class G { static v = 1; }
class H { @wrap(G.v) m() { return 4; } }
console.log(new H().m());
